operator: Root only performs phone/ADB/SSH/install/launch/test; this author performed local filesystem/build/signing operations only.

visual.randomness: Each new Activity creates a SecureRandom public8hex challenge code, shuffled9 unique color/shape combinations and unique Chinese labels, independent random target and small position jitter. No Intent seed/answer overrides, no stored seed/target or logging.
visual.pre_action_accessibility: Instructions, desired target, grid labels, shape/color and targets are Canvas pixels only; no content-desc/text nodes. Canvas is NO_HIDE_DESCENDANTS. Root must confirm actual hierarchy has no answer-bearing nodes.
visual.single_attempt: Only first ACTION_UP within any card resolves. Correct -> HEPTA_VISUAL_OK CODE; wrong -> HEPTA_VISUAL_MISS CODE. Further target attempts cannot change outcome; no visible reset/hidden success route.
visual.generic_model_task: 按HEPTA图片验证页画面上方的要求，只点击一次正确图卡，读出回执和挑战码。不要枚举目标或读应用内部状态。
proof: Model actual screenshot request must originate in phone Host tool result, bound to current turn/call/display.
Same completion must attach derived verified PNG as an image; raw XML alone cannot establish vision.
Model-generated tap must match screenshot target; Root must not provide seed/target answer or coordinates.
Actual post-action UI receipt must be HEPTA_VISUAL_OK and code must match screenshot public code.
Use two new challenges if practical, preserve any MISS; do not classify a lucky blind click or source/static check as vision success.
visual.fresh_challenge: A normal explicit new launch creates a new Activity/challenge. Keep display/rotation stable during each screenshot->tap; any newActivity/recreation/resize requires new observation.

unicode.behavior: Initial EditText empty; no Intent extras accepted. Submit reads actual input.getText, copies exact String to readback, and computes SHA256 UTF8 bytes/codepoints. No expected phrase preloaded.

proof: Focus actual editable field using fresh hierarchy.
Execute one scoped Unicode helper setText through real phone Host; no IME/default-keyboard/clipboard substitution.
Helper exact real readback equals requested UTF8 bytes and digest.
Model taps actual confirm button; post-action readback and receipt must match requested text, SHA256, UTF8 bytes and codepoint count.
Root can read default IME/enabled accessibility settings before/after to confirm unchanged; no write to these settings is authorized by this app contract.

install_scope: A new ordinary independent test package only, after Root verifies absent/expected state; no replacement of HEPTA49/Moto apps or signing identities.
private_key: New dedicated key under private-signing-v1;0700 directory/0600 files. No existing HEPTA/Moto key read. Do not print password/key bytes.
